result.summary: Extracts the duplicated `BlockValidationStateCatcher` helper into a shared header (`node/block_validation_state_catcher.h`) and standardizes its usage across the block template manager, the `submitblock` RPC, and mining test helpers. Replaces custom boolean found flags inside callers with an `std::optional` validation state.
result.problem: Multiple components independently implement almost identical validation state catchers to inspect block validation outcomes via validation interface callbacks, leading to code duplication and minor divergence in how the caught state is stored.
evidence: PR description references previous review feedback requesting deduplication: "As mentioned in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/34644#discussion_r2889315162 and https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35675#discussion_r360301816, the validation state catchers were defined in the block template manager, `submitblock` rpc and mining test helpers, even though they do the same thing."
result.scope_notes: Replaces closed PR #36389 with the same commit on a dedicated branch.
result.card: Deduplicates the BlockValidationStateCatcher helper by moving it into a dedicated node header (node/block_validation_state_catcher.h) and adopting it across the block template manager, the submitblock RPC, and mining test helpers. This resolves duplicate callback-listener logic noted during review discussions on earlier mining and validation PRs (#34644 and #35675). The refactor standardizes the result tracking using an optional validation state without intended behavior changes.
uncertainties: The exact diff was not provided, but the commit message and description give specific filenames and scope.

risk.why: A flaw in the validation callback hook could misreport block validation state in submitblock RPC or block template manager.
